title: Baby born with heart abnormalities ‘didn’t have a chance’ after non-medical free birth, NSW inquest hears
summary_full: Inquest into the deaths of four babies after free and home births hears routine checks and follow-up may have saved their livesGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastFour babies who died in New South Wales – three after free births and one after a home birth – might have survived if they had had routine checks and follow-up , a coronial inquest has heard.Baby DH, Baby D, Baby R, and Baby B died in the state’s northern rivers region between 2022 and 2024.
